item.title: Jesse Nurmi powers London Knights to 6-1 win over Erie
item.description: Jesse Nurmi gave the London Knights steady defensive play up front last year. Now, he is turning into a scoring machine. The Finnish overager recorded the club’s second hat trick in less than a week in a 6-1 drubbing of the Otters before 5,460 Saturday at Erie Insurance Arena. item.title: Four people injured in west London crash
item.description: Four people were taken to hospital early Sunday following a crash in west London. Two vehicles collided at about 2 a.m. at the intersection of Wonderland Road and Oxford Street, the London fire department said in a social media post. Firefighters freed one person who was trapped in a vehicle. Four people suffered serious injuries […]

item.title: Probe of chemicals found in home disrupts street, unnerves neighbours
item.description: Residents who live near a home at the centre of a police probe into hazardous chemicals are speaking out about the continuing investigation that has shut down part of a northwest London street indefinitely. item.title: 'Exercise of empathy': Paramedic, husband sleep overnight in tent
item.description: Amid a stretch of frigid temperatures, a London paramedic and her husband braved the cold in a tent overnight on Saturday to raise awareness of homelessness and collect donations for those in need.
